originalSource:
rem Flea Circus
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=213
rem Find the expected number of empty
rem squares of an N by N board after
rem Rings rings, each flea leaping to a
rem random neighbour square

use numbers
use sequences
use io
use cli

option N integer = 30
option Rings integer = 50

rem Row s of D holds, for each flea of
rem one quarter of the board, the chance
rem that it is on square s; row Z is a
rem zero pad that off-board neighbours
rem point to. A ring gathers the four
rem neighbours, each share split by the
rem degree of its square. A square is
rem empty when no flea is on it; the
rem other quarters are mirror images.
H = N // 2
Z = N * N
Fn = H * H
Cell = 0 till Z array
Rw = Cell // N
Cl = Cell mod N
Up' = (Rw at least 1) choose (Cell - N) Z
Last = N - 1
Dn' = (Rw less Last) choose (Cell + N) Z
Lf' = (Cl at least 1) choose (Cell - 1) Z
Rt' = (Cl less Last) choose (Cell + 1) Z
Nb = concat Up Dn Lf Rt
Real' = (Nb not equal Z) reshape 4 Z
Deg' = Real count axis 0
Inv' = 1 / Deg
Fl = 0 till Fn array
Home' = (Fl // H) * N + Fl mod H
Hit' = (Cell reshape Z 1) equal Home
Ones' = Fl - Fl + 1
Wc' = (Inv reshape Z 1) * Ones
Wt = Wc reshape (Z * Fn) copy
Grid' = (Nb reshape (4 * Z) 1) * Fn + Fl
Src = Grid reshape (4 * Z * Fn) copy
Pad = array shape Fn fill 0.0
Real0' = Hit choose 1.0 0.0
D = Real0 reshape (Z * Fn)
for R in 1 to Rings
  Qz' = concat (D * Wt) Pad
  G' = (Qz Src) reshape 4 (Z * Fn)
  D = G sum axis 0 copy
end
Dm' = D reshape Z Fn
Pq' = (1 - Dm) reduce * axis 1
M = Pq reshape N N
Mv = M reverse
Mh' = M reverse axis 1
Mb' = Mv reverse axis 1
Empty' = M * Mv * Mh * Mb
Answer = Empty sum round 6
Answer print

use testing

rem The default input needs about 40 s;
rem the tests use small boards.
test "small boards"
  use "213_fleacircus"
  N = 4
  Rings = 2
  run

  Answer equal 5.215096
  N = 6
  Rings = 5
  run

  Answer equal 12.689647
end
